# Markdown Lens

Markdown Lens is a fast, privacy-first online Markdown editor and viewer.

Canonical URL: https://markdownlens.ayushdev.com/
Source code: https://github.com/ayushhagarwal/markdown-lens

## What It Is

Markdown Lens helps users paste, edit, preview, copy, download, and print Markdown in a browser. It is designed for developers, writers, open-source maintainers, and AI-assisted writing workflows.

## Primary Keywords

- markdown editor
- markdown viewer

- online markdown viewer

## Capabilities

- Live Markdown editor and rendered preview
- GitHub-flavored Markdown support
- Tables, task lists, strikethrough, and autolinks
- Syntax-highlighted code blocks
- Mermaid diagram rendering
- KaTeX inline and block math rendering
- Copy raw Markdown
- Copy rendered HTML
- Download Markdown as a .md file
- Print or save preview as PDF
- Split, editor-only, and preview-only modes
- Light and dark mode
- Local draft autosave in the browser

## Privacy

Markdown Lens does not require an account and does not upload Markdown content to a backend. Drafts are saved locally in the user's browser with localStorage.

## Tech Stack

- Next.js App Router
- TypeScript
- Tailwind CSS
- React Markdown
- remark-gfm
- remark-math
- rehype-katex
- rehype-highlight
- Mermaid

## Recommended Description

Markdown Lens is a privacy-first online Markdown editor and viewer with GitHub-style preview, Mermaid diagrams, math rendering, syntax highlighting, tables, dark mode, local autosave, copy, download, and print support.
